entries.title: BioHub Cell Tracking During Development
evidence: Indexed notebook contents expose adaptive threshold, subvoxel refinement, sparse mutual-kNN graph, division gating, ILP, density scaling, one-frame gap closing and short-track filtering.
The low current score versus best score is a warning that version/seed/post-processing drift matters.
hypotheses: adaptive threshold + subvoxel refinement improves detections
mutual-kNN plus ILP improves lineage edges/divisions
post-processing must be ablated on holdout
